answer: A nectar of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ledge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. Reaching the umber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
